tagline: Every piece of your agent's harness, with the receipts
brief: A skill for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor that reads the session transcripts your agent already saves, names the harness piece behind each problem and checks whether the fix worked.
criteria: Success: recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, speaks of records and links, distinct from generic AI marks.

concepts.name: Three rings
concepts.idea: Three fused rings, one chain of records: each session is a link in the ledger.
rationale: Reads as a chain of links, which is what a ledger is, with no explanation needed
One union of three rings on a 26-unit grid, so it stays solid down to 16 px
Colours come from the site: ink, amber and, on light backgrounds, a deeper amber

recommendation: Three rings: simple, one colour, and it is the mark the site already uses.
next_steps: Use the favicon and app icon from the kit
